name: GDPR Content Depth & Quality
description: Content depth and quality checks for GDPR compliance — privacy policy word count, cookie consent mechanism, and policy last-updated date.
regulation: GDPR Art. 12(1) — transparent, clear, and plain language; ePrivacy Directive Art. 5(3) — cookie consent

items.description: Privacy policy content depth — word count thresholds (informational, no GDPR minimum)
items.regulation: GDPR Art. 12(1) — transparent and clear language
items.remediation: Expand the privacy policy to cover all processing activities in clear and comprehensive language.

items.description: Cookie consent mechanism — functional opt-in with accept/reject buttons
items.regulation: ePrivacy Directive Art. 5(3) — consent required for non-essential cookies
items.remediation: Add a cookie consent banner with Accept and Reject buttons. Use class names like 'cookie-consent' or similar.

items.description: Policy last updated date — check for a recent revision date in privacy policy
items.regulation: GDPR Art. 12(1) — transparency; informational check only
items.remediation: Add a 'Last updated: [date]' line at the top of the privacy policy and update it when changes are made.
